_comment: J6 target calibration records: one per measured target, each the evidence a frozen
EncodingCostTable was built from. bcir/asn1/calibration.py decides admissibility;
tools/silicon/measure_asn1_calibration.sh produces a record on a declared target.
EMPTY IS A LEGITIMATE STATE, and it is the current one. No target has yet produced an
admissible calibration, so select_certified raises UnmeasuredTarget for every timing
objective rather than selecting on a table nobody measured -- which is the behaviour
J6 designed for and not a gap to be filled with a convenient number.
The session container cannot fill it: it is a shared cloud runner, and a shared runner
is refused for timing thresholds by the same rule that governs the SIMD store. The
first admissible record is expected from a pinned dedicated aarch64 target.
